review.assessment: The change introduces a new file `expo/paging.py` containing pagination logic with a hardcoded page size of 10 and a bug where remainder rows are discarded. It modifies no other files, failing to integrate into the existing pipeline or address the audit failure of missing rows.

findings.call: python -c "from expo.paging import pages; print(sum(len(pg) for pg in pages(list(range(47)))))"
findings.defect: The `pages` function silently drops rows that do not fit into a full page.
findings.expected: All input elements must be preserved (e.g., 47 total)

findings.actual: No behavior change to the application pipeline
findings.defect: The added module is not integrated into `run.py`; importing or adding it without configuration does not affect execution.
findings.expected: Modified pipeline behavior utilizing the new logic
